sources.title: kureiji_ollie_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive Indonesia|hololive ID]]'s [[Kureiji Ollie]].  
 
It consists of a [[torn dress|torn]] [[black dress|black]] [[layered dress]] that exposes [[bare shoulders|her shoulders]] and the [[sarashi]] underneath (although it's partially covered with a [[red bow|red]] [[dress bow|bow]]), [[puffy short sleeves]], [[black corset|black]] [[underbust]] corset, [[wrist ribbon]], bandages on [[bandaged arm|her left arm]] and [[bandaged leg|right leg]] and [[mismatched footwear]] (a [[black boots|black]] [[lace-up boots|lace-up boot]] and a [[red shoes|red]] [[mary janes|mary jane]]).
